entries.text: Ro-to-to-to-to... ♪
entries.label: team_0020_system_01

entries.text: Cassiopeia here.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_01

entries.text: I see you’re getting close to one of Team\nStar’s bases.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_02

entries.text: I take it this means you’ve decided to join\nmy operation?[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_03

entries.text: That’s right
entries.label: team_0020_select_01

entries.text: I guess so
entries.label: team_0020_select_02

entries.text: Thank you.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_04

entries.text: With this, you’re officially a member of\nOperation Starfall![VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_05

entries.text: Hold on a second![VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_01

entries.text: Does this “Operation Starfall” of yours have\nroom for one more member?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_02

entries.text: Wha—? Who are you?![VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_06

entries.text: The name’s Clive.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_03

entries.text: Oh? And how long have you been spying on us?[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_07

entries.text: No need to get your hackles raised.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_04

entries.text: I’m a pal of our mutual friend here. Isn’t that\nright, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_05

entries.text: I guess...maybe?
entries.label: team_0020_select_03

entries.text: We’re not pals!
entries.label: team_0020_select_04

entries.text: Ahaha! Shy as ever, I see![VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_06

entries.text: We’re talking about going up against Team Star\nhere. It’s not something you can join in for fun.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_08

entries.text: I’m well aware. I just need to sort out some...\nunsettled business with Team Star, that’s all.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_07

entries.text: Besides, I tend to get the job done well. Not\nthat you can take my word for it, but it’s true.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_08

entries.text: ... ... ...\c\nI suppose I’m hardly in a position to refuse help.\nWelcome to the operation, Clive.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_09

entries.text: Great. That settles it, then.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_09

entries.text: I think I heard your name earlier... Cassiopeia,\nwas it? Who exactly are you?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_10

entries.text: Team Star and I...share some history. That’s all I’ll\nsay for now.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_10

entries.text: I see. In that case, I won’t press you further.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_11

entries.text: Good. Now, back to business—let’s talk\nOperation Starfall.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_11

entries.text: Yes. What would you have us do?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_12

entries.text: Simply put, I want you to raid each one of\nTeam Star’s bases.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_12

entries.text: Then you’ll defeat the bosses of the team...and\nput an end to their rule![VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_13

entries.text: “Put an end to their rule”...? You mean we need\nto oust these bosses from their roles somehow?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_13

entries.text: That’s right. Team Star is made up of five squads,\nand each of those squads has its own base.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_14

entries.text: You should be able to see the front gates of one\nof those bases now, in fact.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_15

entries.text: Ah, yes...I can see them over there.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_14

entries.text: On the other side of those is the base proper.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_16

entries.text: And somewhere within that base lies one of your\ntargets: a squad boss.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_17

entries.text: OK. I’m starting to get the idea.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_15

entries.text: Well, that’s just the outline. The key to the whole\noperation is the code that the team has to follow.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_18

entries.text: If someone challenges one of the squad bosses\nto a battle, they have no choice but to accept.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_19

entries.text: And what’s more, if they just so happen to lose\nthat battle...\c\nthey must forfeit their role as boss altogether![VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_20

entries.text: I went ahead and issued challenges to each base\nunder your name, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].\c\nThey’re basically declarations of war.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_21

entries.text: Now all of Team Star knows that we’re looking\nfor a fight.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_22

entries.text: So let’s say we defeat all the bosses and they\nstep down from their roles... What happens next?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_16

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_23

entries.text: The rest of the team crumbles with no one left to\nlead them. That’s what happens.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_24

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_17

entries.text: It’s a solid plan, but not without wrinkles.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_25

entries.text: Each base has a bunch of Pokémon inside to\nfend off intruders, and the bases themselves are\r\na considerable size.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_26

entries.text: Your garden-variety Trainer would be overrun\nlong before they’d get anywhere near the boss.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_27

entries.text: That’s why your skills are essential to this\noperation, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_28

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_29

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_30

entries.text: Defeat the Pokémon inside the base, and drag\nthe boss out from where they’re hiding.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_31

entries.text: First things first, though—you’ll need to deal with\nany grunts that might be guarding the front gates.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_32

entries.text: And what will you be doing in the meantime?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_18

entries.text: Like I said before, I have a history with Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_33

entries.text: That means I can’t operate out in the open.\nI’ll back you up from afar.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_34

entries.text: All right. And what will my role be?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_19

entries.text: Sorry, but I don’t trust you completely just yet...\c\nFor now, I’d like you to monitor the bases and\nact as [VAR 0x0100(0000)]’s support.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_35

entries.text: You’re a cautious one, all right... I respect that.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_20

entries.text: I’ll be in touch again when the plan advances to\nthe next stage. Good hunting out there.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0020_cassiopeia_36

entries.text: Welp. Go get ’em, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_21

entries.text: Director Clavell...?
entries.label: team_0020_select_05

entries.text: You look familiar...
entries.label: team_0020_select_06

entries.text: I have no idea what you mean. But if anyone asks\nyou about me, remember this...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_22

entries.text: I’m Clive, a normal academy student just like you.\nNothing more, nothing less.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0020_nelke_23
